exec: const p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0'); const d=new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate()+7); const day=`${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth()+1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`; pm.environment.set('futureDate',day); pm.environment.set('futureStart',day+'T19:00:00'); pm.environment.set('futureStartOverlap',day+'T20:00:00');
